name: Split the Sky
body:
Design invocation ; Level 7

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes

EFFECT

Range 1 mile
Area 1-mile-radius circle, centered on you; see text
Duration 4d12 hours; see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You change the weather in the local area. This functions as control weather, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the range and area increases by 1 mile, the duration increases by 1d12 hours, and the time it takes for the weather to change is reduced by 2 minutes.
